sloka: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.८३.९ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadvākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ ।bharataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.83.9 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having heard this speech of Rama, Bharata, who was skilled in speech, spoke these words with folded hands.
